name: hono-drizzle-just-template
description: A reusable Bun, Hono, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL backend template.

scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:integration
scripts.check:fast: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.check: bun run db:migrations:verify && bun run check:fast
scripts.openapi:lint: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true bun node_modules/@redocly/cli/bin/cli.js lint --extends=spec openapi/openapi.json
scripts.openapi:contract: bun run openapi:verify && bun run openapi:lint && bun run openapi:validate
scripts.ci:integration: bun run db:migrate && bun run test:integration
scripts.ci:e2e: bun run db:migrate && bun run test:e2e
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run openapi:contract && bun run test:coverage && bun run ci:integration && bun run test:e2e
scripts.db:migrations:verify: drizzle-kit check && drizzle-kit generate && git diff --exit-code -- drizzle
